en: A sepia-toned image depicting two traditional half-timbered villas labeled as 'Villa Sorgenfrei' and 'Villa Bergeshöhe.' The setting appears rural with some fencing in the foreground, a dirt road, and several people standing near one of the houses. There is a large tree to the left. The text is in German and mentions 'Oberbärenburg i. sächs. Erzgeb.' indicating a locality in the Saxon Ore Mountains.
